gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
___ (FORTUNE), the package had already been delivered.
gaps.explanation: The sentence adverb is 'Fortunately' — luckily for us.

gaps.sentence: The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.
